latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Medical Record Translator skill.
- Provides structure-preserving translation for medical records, reports, and prescriptions.
- Supports both text-based and scanned PDFs with correct workflow for each type.
- Maintains strict 1:1 block mapping and document structure (tables, key-values, free text).
- Outputs Chinese-first, doctor-readable Markdown with original text for each section.
- Includes privacy notice and references to external output and quality standards.
- If you want more language support, drop me a note or send email to info@chinamed.cc.
